name: Frey Knowles
source:
Frey's diligent training and hard work made her one of the strongest student, yet she has barely any friends due to her cold demeanor.  However, she cares for her family dearly as she dotes on her sister Sofia.

[spoiler]Frey seeks to become a Seikishi in order to regain her family's honor after her father is arrested for murder.  She and her family wants to see her father once again.[/spoiler]
